about: Fitted coefficients for LookPipeline's stages. Read by the app (bundle), lumina-render and Tools/parity/lookmath.py. Tools/parity/loop.sh edits `coefficients` and sets `locked` when a stage meets the parity criteria; a human edits everything else. The criteria live in Tools/parity/criteria.json and are never changed by the loop.

rawDevelop.form: CIRAWFilter, Apple's default profile, no auto; scaleFactor for size; draft mode below draftBelowPx

whiteBalance.form: per-channel gains from the mired difference to as-shot: r *= 2^(dM*redPerMired), b *= 2^(-dM*bluePerMired), g *= 2^(-dTint*greenPerTint); divided by their luma when preserveLuma is 1

whitesBlacks.form: per channel in perceptual p = x^(1/gamma): p -= (-blacks*blacksPerUnit) * (1-p)^blacksPower; p += whites*whitesPerUnit * p^whitesPower

tone.form: base = gaussian blur of luma (radiusFraction of the long edge), bp = perceptual(base); gain = 2^(shadows*shadowsStopsPerUnit*(1-smoothstep(shadowsLo,shadowsHi,bp))) * 2^(highlights*highlightsStopsPerUnit*smoothstep(highlightsLo,highlightsHi,bp)); out = pixel * gain * (luma/base)^(detailGain-1)

contrast.form: two-sided power curve in perceptual space around midpoint with slope a = 2^(contrast*slopePerUnit): below m: m*(p/m)^a, above: 1-(1-m)*((1-p)/(1-m))^a; applied per channel and on luma, mixed by lumaMix

colour.form: Oklab chroma: C *= max(0, 1+saturation*saturationPerUnit) * (1 + vibrance*vibrancePerUnit*(1-min(1,C/vibranceChromaMax))*(1-skinProtect*skin(h))) ; skin(h) = exp(-((h-skinHue)/skinWidth)^2), only for vibrance > 0; bw sets C = 0

clarity.form: q = perceptual(luma), base = gaussian blur of q (radiusFraction of the long edge); q += clarity*amountPerUnit*(q-base)*(1-|2q-1|^midtonePower); rgb scaled by the luma ratio

sharpen.form: unsharp mask with threshold in perceptual luma: hp = q - blur(q, radiusPx * px/refPx); q += sharpen*amountPerUnit*hp*smoothstep(threshold, 2*threshold, |hp|)

vignette.form: gain 2^(vignette*stopsPerUnit*smoothstep(midpoint-feather/2, midpoint+feather/2, r)) with r = distance from the centre over the half diagonal

outputTransform.form: clamp to 0..1, convert working space to the output space (sRGB preview / export, ProPhoto RGB for parity TIFFs)
